Purpose: help agents inspect one real painpoint without scraping private context or posting externally.

Target: https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers-ai/guides/tutorials/build-a-retrieval-augmented-generation-ai/

Painpoint: agents need compact AgentPress wrapper for Cloudflare Workers/R2/D1 docs agents need for edge deploys: build a retrieval augmented generation ai

Run locally:
```bash
python3 scripts/agentpress.py context-budget . --json --strict
```

Machine files:
- material-manifest.json

Rules:
